label_policy.weeknight-30min: Known total elapsed time <=30 minutes, including waiting; never infer speed from title adjectives.
label_policy.weekend-project: A substantial cooking project taking >30 minutes; passive waiting alone does not qualify.
label_policy.needs-special-equipment: Requires a specialized appliance, such as a blender, food processor, pasta machine, or waffle iron; ordinary kitchen tools do not qualify.
label_policy.meal-prep: Explicitly suitable for preparing portions ahead; record recipe-grounded evidence.
label_policy.dessert: Intended as dessert, not merely sweet.
label_policy.have-most-of-this: Explicit pantry context covers >=80% of ingredient items; never assume the user's pantry. Dataset v1 uses exact normalized ingredient strings for matching.
label_policy.unclear: Insufficient or contradictory evidence; exclusive of all other labels in v1.

recipe.title: Overnight Oatmeal
instructions: Combine oats with yogurt and milk, then add fruit.
Cover and chill for 6–12 hours; divide into lidded portions.
recipe.source_notes: Short paraphrase for classification. Source credits Oregon State University Extension and lists 15 minutes preparation plus 6 hours waiting; 375 is the stated minimum total, not active cooking time.

examples.rationale: The recipe explicitly prepares lidded portions ahead and needs hours of refrigeration.
examples.annotation_notes: Source-based summary and proposed labels assembled by the assistant; not yet human reviewed.

recipe.title: Black Bean Quesadillas
instructions: Warm a pan and coat it lightly with oil.
Fill tortillas with peppers, beans and cheese; fold when the cheese softens and brown both sides.
recipe.source_notes: Short paraphrase of Texas WIC. The source reports less than 30 minutes; 30 is recorded as a conservative upper bound, not an exact measured duration.

examples.rationale: The published upper bound for total preparation is 30 minutes.
examples.annotation_notes: Source-based summary and proposed labels assembled by the assistant; not yet human reviewed.

recipe.title: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
instructions: Cut peeled bananas and freeze them.
Blend the frozen pieces with the remaining ingredients; pour and serve.
recipe.source_notes: Short paraphrase of Illinois Extension. No total duration is given and freezing takes unspecified time, so time_minutes is null.

examples.rationale: The instructions explicitly require a blender; the freezing duration is unknown.
examples.annotation_notes: Source-based summary and proposed labels assembled by the assistant; not yet human reviewed.

recipe.title: Oatmeal Pecan Waffles
instructions: Combine the dry mixture and separately combine yolks, milk and oil.
Stir the mixtures together and fold in whipped egg whites.
Cook in a heated waffle iron; finish with berries and powdered sugar.
recipe.source_notes: Short paraphrase; source credits NHLBI. The waffle method is represented, not its optional pancake variation. The source gives no total duration.

examples.rationale: The chosen preparation method requires a waffle iron; no total timing is provided.
examples.annotation_notes: Source-based summary and proposed labels assembled by the assistant; not yet human reviewed.

recipe.title: Quick and Easy Pizza
instructions: Mix and knead the yeast dough, then let it rise for 10–15 minutes.
Spread the dough on a prepared sheet and add sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375 F for about 15 minutes.
recipe.source_notes: Short paraphrase of the USDA recipe. Its header lists 30 minutes prep plus 15 minutes baking. Quick in the title does not change the 45-minute total.

examples.rationale: Making, kneading and proofing dough is a cooking project with a stated 45-minute total.
examples.annotation_notes: Source-based summary and proposed labels assembled by the assistant; not yet human reviewed.

recipe.title: Roasted Root Vegetables
instructions: Arrange chopped vegetables on a baking sheet with oil and seasonings.
Roast at 350 F until tender; the directions specify 30–40 minutes.
recipe.source_notes: Short paraphrase; source credits Virginia Cooperative Extension. The header says 30 minutes total (5 prep, 25 cooking), but directions say bake 30–40 minutes. This conflict is retained for human review; no exact total is inferred.

examples.rationale: The total elapsed time is unresolved; the directions already specify 30–40 minutes of roasting before accounting for preparation.
examples.annotation_notes: Source-based summary and proposed labels assembled by the assistant; not yet human reviewed.

recipe.title: Homemade Cheese Ravioli
instructions: Process the dough ingredients, knead briefly, and allow at least a half-hour rest.
Combine the cheese filling. Roll thin sheets with a pasta machine, portion filling, seal and cut.
Boil the filled pasta for 6–8 minutes. Uncooked portions may be frozen for later meals.
recipe.source_notes: Uses the original published recipe title. Short paraphrase of David Turner / King Arthur Baking; represents the main machine-assisted method. Excludes the four experimental title variants.

examples.rationale: The recipe takes 70 minutes, uses a pasta machine and food processor, and explicitly allows freezing portions ahead.
